symptom: Unified Brain Delivery push runs failed immediately without jobs while the workflow accumulated duplicate handoff/BG169 blocks and a malformed turbo lane.
root_cause: Repeated append-style autonomous workflow edits were composed non-idempotently on one active lineage, duplicating YAML job structure and corrupting the turbo shell block.
fix: Restore the workflow deterministically from the last exact-head that completed BRAIN delivery successfully.
Apply the turbo lane as one bounded replacement rather than append fragments.
Keep a single lanes job, a single handoff job and a single BG169 production transport.
